scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run prepare:demo && vite build
scripts.build:test: pnpm run prepare:demo && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p apps/website/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('dist-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.lint: pnpm run prepare:demo && pnpm --dir ../.. exec biome check apps/website && cargo clippy --locked --lib --manifest-path ../../packages/planner/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run build:test && node --test dist-tests/tests/*.test.js && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prepare:demo && pnpm --dir ../.. exec tsc -p apps/website/tsconfig.json --noEmit
